name: Brown Butter Banana Bread Oatmeal Cookies
desc: Chewy oatmeal chocolate cookies with brown butter, mashed banana and a little yogurt.

source.title: Brown Butter Banana Bread Oatmeal Cookies
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3/4 cup (170g) packed brown sugar, light or dark
1 1/2 cups (300g) semisweet chocolate chips or chopped dark chocolate
ingredients.item: semisweet chocolate chips or chopped dark chocolate

steps: Brown the butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, 5-8 min. It foams and sizzles, the foam subsides, and the milk solids turn deep brown and smell nutty. Pour into a large bowl and cool 10 min.
In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, oats, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Whisk both sugars into the brown butter, then the banana, yogurt and vanilla, until combined.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet until just combined, then fold in the chocolate.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 min. Meanwhile heat the oven to 375°F and line 2 baking sheets with parchment.
Scoop 3 tbsp balls onto the sheets, spaced 3 in apart.
Bake 12-14 min, until the edges are golden and the middles still look soft.
Cool 5-10 min on the pan, then move to a rack. Sprinkle with flaky salt.
tips: The creator's website version swaps the yogurt for 1 room-temperature egg yolk.
